item.title: Three F-15Es Down Over Kuwait From Friendly Fire
item.description: On the third day of Operation Epic Fury, three US Air Force F-15E Strike Eagles were shot down over Kuwait by Kuwaiti air defenses in a friendly fire incident that US Central Command confirmed Monday.
